text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Screeeeech!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day we leave for Europe has finally
arrived. If
we want to enter an
international G1 race, it's
best to run in
a lighter race first.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. We won't be back till fall,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's make sure we bring a big trophy
back with
us as a souvenir.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, let's head out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pop!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Now I've done it...
choice_data_list: 今、何かヘンな音がしたようだけど
choice_data_list_en: Sounded like there was a weird noise just now...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I messed up. I made a really cool turn
around that
corner, and ended up
twisting my ankle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wee woo wee woo...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: How can you be so dumb!?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet's voice seems to pierce
through the
walls of the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You made a huge deal out of going
abroad! You
even got me involved in it
and caused a huge
commotion!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And then you twist your ankle, not even during training, but at the airport?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I get it. I'm pathetic. Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Things like this happen sometimes. You
can't
have sunshine every day.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm not talking about sunshine! What are
you
going to do now?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's... up to Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess there's no helping it.
choice_data_list: とりあえず遠征は取り止めだ
とりあえず遠征は取り止めだよ
choice_data_list_en: For now, the expedition is canceled.
For now, we're calling off the expedition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We have no choice but to rest for a few
days and
then start reorganizing
ourselves for autumn.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But... this might be a good thing for me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you went abroad and never came
back, we
might've never settled our
unfinished business.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
When you said you were going to the
Derby, I felt
like you were just some
kind of aimless, impulsive
punk.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd close the book on our
rivalry right
there. But then...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I saw you in the Derby and felt like I
lost. You
were on a whole different
level.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I realized then that there was no way
you could
do what you did unless you
were truly strong
inside. I was absolutely
speechless...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Really? I coulda sworn you said ya
weren't even
gonna watch the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I know! But I watched it anyway! J-just
cause I was
bored and it happened to be
on the TV!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, since you weren't in the
Japanese Oaks,
I swore I'd find another
race to settle our score...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So hurry up and get better, okay?
You're tough,
so I'm sure you'll heal up
in no time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
While you're recovering from your
setback, I'm
going to be getting
stronger! I'll be so strong that
you'll
definitely want to run against me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Just wait until fall. I'm not letting you off the hook. Or more like, you'll be begging to race me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And I'll be the one to walk away
victorious. You'd
better be ready.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Scarlet...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right. I have no idea what's gonna
happen, but
this is me we're talkin'
about.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When the time comes, I'll be there to
run.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph. I'm holding you to that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
See you later. You'll be sleeping here
tonight,
won't you? Go ahead and get
some rest. I'll take
your suitcases back to
our room.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man, she's a fiery one. But... I think I
might have
caused her some trouble.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And you too, Trainer. After all you did
to get us
ready to go.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haha. You sure are crazy, partner. Completely different from her.
choice_data_list: 気にするな、飽きなくて楽しい
気にしないで、飽きなくて楽しい
choice_data_list_en: Don't sweat it, it keeps things interesting.
Don't worry about it, it never gets old and it's fun.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Welp, I guess I'll be sleeping in my own
lameness
tonight. I'm sure the sun will
come out again
someday...
